title: OpenBMB/PilotDeck: a desktop workspace for task-oriented agents
friendlyTitle: PilotDeck is a desktop app for agent tasks
summary: PilotDeck, from OpenBMB, is an AGPL-3.0 desktop platform for task-oriented agent work. The project describes itself as a workspace-centric agent operating system, and it shipped release v2026.10.17 on 16 October. It has about 4,600 stars and gained 60 stars on GitHub's TypeScript trending list today.
friendlySummary: PilotDeck is an open-source desktop app for running agent work as tasks. OpenBMB calls it a workspace for agents. A new release landed on 16 October. It has about 4,600 stars and gained 60 stars on GitHub today.
whyItMatters: If you want agent work organized as tasks in a desktop app, rather than only as a terminal session, PilotDeck is a current open-source place to try that. The AGPL licence has sharing duties if you run a modified copy as a service, so read it before you build a product on top.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it if you want agent work in a desktop app instead of only in a terminal. The licence asks you to share changes if you offer a modified copy as a service, so read that before you build on it.
